instruction: Repair calendar_math.add_months(text, months). text is a valid YYYY-MM-DD date in years 1900..2100; months is an integer in -120..120. Add calendar months, preserving day-of-month when possible and otherwise clamping to the last day of the target month. Return YYYY-MM-DD. Correctly handle negative offsets, year rollover, century leap rules, and zero offset. Inputs are valid; do not use elapsed-day approximations.
